title: SIN, COS and TAN of negative angles, of large angles and of multiples of pi
note: SIN, COS and TAN take radians: values for negative and large angles to within 1.0E-5 (SIN(100.0) = -0.5063656, COS(1000.0) = 0.5623791, SIN(-10000.0) = -0.3056144, TAN(-0.5) = -0.5463025); the sine of pi is 0 to the precision of the REAL pi; an angle of 100000 or more is reduced modulo 2 pi without losing its low bits, so SIN(1.0E6) = -0.3499935, COS(1.0E9) = -0.9395, SIN(1.0E11) = 0.9262 and TAN(1.0E7) are the sine, cosine and tangent of the REAL; the largest REALs give a finite value, inside -1 to 1 for the sine
